newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes 0.9 lower at 997.65.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes 0.9 lower at 997.65.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 90 centavos lower at at 997.65 in quiet and uneventful trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
It was the sixth consecutive session in which the peso, which has edged up sharply since late June, closed lower against the dollar.
"The market was stable and quiet," one dealer said in a telephone interview. "There were some dollar sales by coffee exporters and the Treasury but nothing especially big."
Dealers reported 183 trades for a total of $112 million and said the peso hit an intra-day low of 997.90 before gaining slightly ahead of the close.
